title: ride
description: Makes entities ride other entities, stops entities from riding, makes rides evict their riders, or summons rides or riders.

riders.title: riders
riders.description: Specifies riders using player name or [target selector](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors)s.

ride.title: ride
ride.description: Specifies the entity to ride on. A player name or [target selector](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors).

howtofill.title: howToFill
howtofill.description: One of `if_group_fits` to check whether riders can ride and only makes them ride if possible. Or `until_full` which makes them ride until rides is full. Default: `until_full`.

rides.title: rides
rides.description: Specifies the ridden entities. Must be a player name or entity selector.

entitytype.title: entityType
entitytype.description: Specifies entities to summon. Must be the name`ID`of something that can be summoned.

spawnevent.title: spawnEvent
spawnevent.description: Specifies the in-game event to call the summoned entities. Must be a spawn event in behavior pack.

nametag.title: nameTag
nametag.description: Specifies the name of summoned entities.
